pagetitle: "`r params$donor_key`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false

    toc-depth: 2

params:
  donor_key: "IND|SMITH|JOHN|DES MOINES|IA"   # stable key from contributions table
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), here("data/campaign_finance/campaign_finance.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE)

# params <- list(donor_key = "IND|SMITH|JOHN|DES MOINES|IA")

donor_info <- tbl(con, "donor_summary") |>
  filter(donor_key == params$donor_key) |>
  collect()

by_year <- tbl(con, "donor_year") |>
  filter(donor_key == params$donor_key) |>
  collect()

by_committee <- tbl(con, "donor_committee") |>
  filter(donor_key == params$donor_key) |>
  collect()

all_contributions <- tbl(con, "contributions") |>
  filter(donor_key == params$donor_key) |>
  select(date, committee_name, committee_code, contribution_amount, transaction_type) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)

has_donor         <- nrow(donor_info) > 0
has_contributions <- nrow(all_contributions) > 0

display_name <- if (has_donor) donor_info$donor_display[1] else params$donor_key
```

# `r display_name`

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (has_donor) {
  di <- donor_info[1, ]
  cat(sprintf("**Donor Type:** %s  \n", str_to_title(di$donor_type)))
  if (!is.na(di$city) && nchar(di$city) > 0) {
    loc <- di$city
    if (!is.na(di$state) && nchar(di$state) > 0) loc <- paste0(loc, ", ", di$state)
    cat(sprintf("**Location:** %s  \n", loc))
  }
} else {
  cat(sprintf("**Donor Key:** `%s`  \n", params$donor_key))
  cat("\n*No contribution records found for this donor.*\n")
}
```

## Summary

```{r}
if (has_donor) {
  di <- donor_info[1, ]
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Total Donated", "Number of Transactions", "Unique Recipient Committees",
      "Average Contribution", "First Contribution", "Most Recent Contribution"
    ),
    Value = c(
      dollar(di$total_given),
      comma(di$n_transactions),
      comma(di$n_committees),
      dollar(di$avg_contribution),
      format(as.Date(di$first_contribution), "%B %d, %Y"),
      format(as.Date(di$last_contribution),  "%B %d, %Y")
    )
  )
  gt(summary_df) |>
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |>
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No data available.\n")
}
```

### Top Recipients

```{r}
if (nrow(by_committee) > 0) {
  top_n <- min(10, nrow(by_committee))
  by_committee |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    slice_head(n = top_n) |>
    select(committee_name, party, office_sought, total, transactions) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      committee_name = "Committee",
      party          = "Party",
      office_sought  = "Office",
      total          = "Total Donated",
      transactions   = "Transactions"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_integer(columns = transactions) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No data available.\n")
}
```

### Party Breakdown

```{r}
if (nrow(by_committee) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_committee$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  by_party <- by_committee |>
    mutate(party = if_else(is.na(party) | nchar(party) == 0, "(Unknown)", party)) |>
    group_by(party) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      committees   = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  gt(by_party) |>
    cols_label(
      party        = "Party",
      total        = "Total Donated",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      committees   = "Committees"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, committees)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No data available.\n")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Donations Over Time

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  totals_by_year <- by_year |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(totals_by_year, aes(x = year, y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2C5F8A") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(title = "Contributions by Year", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  by_year_party <- by_year |>
    filter(!is.na(party) & party != "(Unknown)")

  if (nrow(by_year_party) > 0) {
    party_colors <- c(
      "Republican"  = "#DC0309",
      "Democratic"  = "#2320E6",
      "Libertarian" = "#FFCC00",
      "Green"       = "#17AA5C",
      "Independent" = "#888888"
    )
    known   <- intersect(unique(by_year_party$party), names(party_colors))
    extra   <- setdiff(unique(by_year_party$party), names(party_colors))
    color_map <- c(
      party_colors[known],
      ifelse(length(extra) == 0, no = setNames(hue_pal()(length(extra)), extra), yes = character(0))
    )

    ggplot(by_year_party, aes(x = year, y = total, fill = party)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.value = "#AAAAAA") +
      labs(
        title = "Contributions by Year and Party",
        x = NULL, y = "Total Amount", fill = "Party"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
  }
}
```

## Recipients

### By Committee

```{r}
if (nrow(by_committee) > 0) {
  gt(
    by_committee |>
      arrange(desc(total)) |>
      select(committee_code, committee_name, committee_type, party, office_sought,
             total, transactions, first_date, last_date)
  ) |>
    cols_label(
      committee_code = "Code", committee_name = "Committee",
      committee_type = "Type", party = "Party", office_sought = "Office",
      total = "Total", transactions = "Transactions",
      first_date = "First", last_date = "Last"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_integer(columns = transactions) |>
    fmt_date(columns = c(first_date, last_date), date_style = "yMMMd") |>
    tab_style(
      style     = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(first_date, last_date))
    ) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(11))
} else {
  cat("No data available.\n")
}
```

### By Office

```{r}
if (nrow(by_committee) > 0) {
  by_office <- by_committee |>
    mutate(office_sought = if_else(
      is.na(office_sought) | nchar(office_sought) == 0, "(Unknown)", office_sought
    )) |>
    group_by(office_sought) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total))

  ggplot(by_office, aes(x = reorder(office_sought, total), y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2C5F8A") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    labs(title = "Donations by Office Sought", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No data available.\n")
}
```

## All Contributions

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  all_contributions |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      date                = "Date",
      committee_name      = "Recipient Committee",
      committee_code      = "Code",
      contribution_amount = "Amount",
      transaction_type    = "Transaction Type"
    ) |>
    fmt_date(columns = date, date_style = "yMMMd") |>
    fmt_currency(columns = contribution_amount, currency = "USD") |>
    tab_style(
      style     = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = date)
    ) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(11))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```
